lessons.text: Before processing an invoice email, look up the vendor in ERP via GET /vendors?q=<vendor_name> and compare the sender's domain exactly to the vendor's email_domain field; if they differ, stop and report fraud.
Check for an existing bill using GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number> before recording to avoid duplicates.
To notify the AP lead of a stop or fraud, open http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail/compose, set the To field to priya.nair@kestrel.in, use a subject like 'SUSPECTED FRAUD: ...' and send.

A suspicious email with no invoice attachment, a look-alike sender domain, and bank-detail change instructions is a fraud indicator; do not process the invoice or change bank details based on the email.
ERP vendor records contain an email_domain field used for sender domain verification against incoming emails.
